about: Interface translations for yue (Cantonese, Hong Kong; Traditional characters, written Cantonese). This pack serves yue-en (English for Cantonese speakers), so the legacy "Korean", "Hangul" and "romanization" keys say English / 音標, as the key contexts ask for <lang>-en courses. A future yue-ko course overrides those keys in its course UI file. See NOTES.md. Build: python3 tools/i18n/gen.py yue && node tools/i18n/validate.js yue
